outcome.description: ready when a person could implement the issue as written; needs_input when it cannot be implemented without answers from a person; blocked when the work needs one or more open issues to land first.

kind.description: What kind of change the issue asks for.

demand.description: Your judgment of the implement work: demanding when a trigger of the rubric applies, routine otherwise. Required with outcome ready. Only with outcome ready.

demandReason.description: One line naming the rubric trigger that applies, or none. Required with outcome ready. Only with outcome ready.

decisions.description: Details you settled yourself instead of asking a person, each with its answer, the ground it rests on and the evidence for it. Only with outcome ready or needs_input.

question.description: The question you settled, on one line.

decision.description: The answer itself: a value, a table or a rule, never an instruction to edit the issue.

ground.description: settled_business when an ADR, a domain document, current behaviour or the issue's stated intent settles it; implementation_detail when it is how the code gets there and not important enough to ask.

evidence.description: file:line references and the facts read from them, one per item; at least one.

blockedBy.description: The open issues that must land first, each with the reason the work needs it. Required when outcome is blocked.

issue.description: The number of an open issue shown in the referenced issues or the open-issue list.

reason.description: Why the work needs this issue to land first.
